local_memory.description: Enable bounded workspace facts and exact-artifact notes; defaults to true. Disable together with all Knowledge tools for a knowledge-off control.

collect_argv.description: Explicit trusted read-only collector for an existing admitted adapter action; never inferred by appending flags to its executor.

replay_plugin.description: Optional Pi replay plugin. Missing configuration disables agent replay tools and compaction-triggered replay; immutable crash-recovery checkpoints remain mandatory.
